valuation.method: Forward Tangible Net Asset Value (TNAV) per ADR x P/TBV (12-month horizon). Q3 2026 TNAV of 359p per ordinary share converted at 1 ADR = 2 ordinary shares and GBP/USD 1.3212 (2026-11-13 close) equals $9.49 per ADR.

bear.driver: NIM compression from deposit competition and loan impairment rate rising above 25 bps
bear.assumption: Forward TNAV $10.20 at 1.30x P/TBV (RoTE compressing toward 14-15%)

base.driver: Sustained ~19% RoTE per FY2026 guidance (£17.9bn income, £8.5bn costs, >240 bps capital generation)

bull.driver: Resilient >20% RoTE into 2027 with continued share buybacks and Evelyn Partners accretion

valuation.implied_by_close: At Q3 2026 TNAV of $9.49 per ADR, the $15.83 close implies 1.67x trailing P/TBV (1.49x base forward TNAV of $10.60). The $21.15 USD consensus target implies 2.00x base forward TNAV.
valuation.sensitivity: A 0.25x turn in P/TBV moves the base target by $2.65 (16.7 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Full-year 2026 RoTE (guidance >19%), NIM trajectory into 2027, and loan impairment rate (<25 bps)

analyst_notes: All four named analysts hold Buy/Overweight ratings with targets ranging from $19.42 to $22.72 (735p-860p converted at 2x ordinary shares and 1.3212 GBP/USD). Post-Q3 2026 updates (such as Barclays trimming from 850p to 800p) reflect slight adjustments for 2027 NIM expectations and UK bank surcharge discussions, though targets remain above our $18.55 base case.
